audited_source_git.identity_scope: This records the source audited for the revision. The April benchmark archive did not retain the loaded compiled extension or a source commit, so bitwise identity with the archived executable cannot be asserted.

effort_protocol.best: Derived exactly a posteriori from fitted trees and fold-specific training data.
effort_protocol.extra_tree: Derived a posteriori as one random-threshold gain per sampled non-constant feature at a node.

timing_protocol.cv_splitter: Integer cv=N_FOLDS, so sklearn uses deterministic KFold / StratifiedKFold with shuffle=False.
timing_protocol.fit_time_scope: Estimator fit only; dataset fetch, subsampling, CSV writing, and scoring happen outside the reported fit_time.

benchmark_provenance_limit: benchmark_metadata.json records runtime package versions, platform, seed range, fixed-fold protocol, and the loaded treeple path. The temporary loaded extension path and exact sharded shell command were not retained; source hashes identify the independently audited revision sources rather than proving bitwise identity with that binary.

dataset_family_sensitivity.estimand: equal family weight after within-family median aggregation
dataset_family_sensitivity.other_entries: all remaining PMLB entries are singleton families
dataset_family_sensitivity.regression_aliases: 197_cpu_act/573_cpu_act and 227_cpu_small/562_cpu_small are exact duplicate pairs and are each collapsed to one family
dataset_family_sensitivity.regression_friedman_entries: 62 related fri_c entries are collapsed into five generator families c0-c4 by within-family median

deferred: S_par is excluded from confirmatory inference and substantive claims because its archived regression and classification calibrations contain implementation defects.
Simultaneous confidence bands across every screened variant are not reported; all-variant intervals are marginal and exploratory.
Uncertainty from drawing new CV partitions is not estimable from the archived fold-averaged files and would require a new nested-resampling benchmark.
The primary joint claim is restricted to the revision-designated task-specific 1.0 margin; 0.5 and 2.5 form one multiplicity-adjusted sensitivity family.

estimands.centroid_mean: equal-weight mean across dataset-level median points (Figure 1 centroid)
estimands.cross_dataset_median: median across dataset-level median points (summary-table estimand)
estimands.dataset_point: median across random-seed runs after same-run pairing to exhaustive CART

joint_reliability.definition: fraction of dataset-level run-median points meeting both constraints

limitations: PMLB is a curated convenience benchmark, not a random probability sample; between-dataset intervals quantify empirical benchmark heterogeneity and only conditionally support broader generalization.
CV folds were deterministic and fixed across runs. Run-level intervals describe estimator-seed and timing variability, not uncertainty from drawing new train/test partitions.
Each archived run contains fold-averaged outcomes, so fold-level dependence cannot be reconstructed from these files.
Percentile intervals are marginal, not simultaneous confidence bands across all methods.
Wall-clock observations were collected on one hardware/software configuration and do not directly generalize to other systems.
Circular run-block resampling can reveal sensitivity to serial run-order dependence but cannot remove fixed method-order bias within benchmark runs.
The original all-method complete-case corpus included S_par; its influence on entry retention cannot be reconstructed from the archived successful-run files.
The exact sharded benchmark invocation was not retained. Because the executable default imposes n*p <= 1,000,000, the archive cannot verify that this cap was disabled.

multiple_comparisons.confirmatory_set_requirement: all ten keys are mandatory in every task; analysis fails if any key is absent
multiple_comparisons.exploratory_policy: all non-representative variants receive descriptive intervals only and are excluded from confirmatory tests; archived S_par rows are additionally excluded because the implementation audit found calibration defects
multiple_comparisons.joint_simultaneous_success_test: one-sided exact binomial test of whether more than half of dataset entries simultaneously have positive time saving and loss below the margin
multiple_comparisons.loss_margin_sign_support: exact one-sided sign tests of P_dataset(loss < margin | non-tie) > 0.5
multiple_comparisons.omnibus: Friedman rank test across revision-designated representative methods using complete dataset blocks
multiple_comparisons.post_hoc: two-sided paired Wilcoxon signed-rank tests versus exhaustive CART, limited to revision-designated representatives
multiple_comparisons.post_hoc_adjustment: Holm family-wise-error correction separately within each task and metric
multiple_comparisons.primary_adjustment: Holm across the nine non-baseline representative methods within each task at the task-specific 1.0 margin
multiple_comparisons.runtime_superiority_support: exact one-sided sign tests of P_dataset(time saved > 0 | non-tie) > 0.5, Holm-adjusted within task
multiple_comparisons.sensitivity_adjustment: Holm across all 18 method-by-margin hypotheses within each task; sensitivity findings are not labeled primary confirmation

resampling.between: resample complete datasets as clusters; hold observed run medians fixed
resampling.cv_folds: not resampled because benchmark folds are fixed and fold scores were archived only as summaries
resampling.hierarchical: resample datasets by identity, then select a paired-run bootstrap draw for every sampled dataset occurrence
resampling.resample_pairing_key: ordered tuple of actual valid dataset identities
resampling.within: resample run identifiers within dataset; use one shared draw across all methods and metrics

s_par_archive_disposition.classification_defect: the implemented inverse-normal approximation reverses the quantile sign, so upper requested quantiles act as corresponding lower quantiles
s_par_archive_disposition.raw_archive_policy: raw rows and descriptive interval outputs are retained solely for auditability; correcting either defect would define a new implementation and require a new S_par benchmark
s_par_archive_disposition.regression_defect: the fitted proxy includes a target-translation-dependent node constant rather than fitting the between-child gain alone
s_par_archive_disposition.status: defective archived proxy-parametric ablation; excluded from main results, rankings, recommendations, theory validation, and confirmatory inference

timing_serial_sensitivity.bootstrap: paired circular moving-block bootstrap over ordered run positions for dataset medians and equal-weight global centroids
timing_serial_sensitivity.interpretation: assesses sensitivity to serial run-order dependence but cannot remove bias from a fixed method evaluation order within each run
timing_serial_sensitivity.run_index_diagnostics: dataset-method Spearman trend, linear slope, and first-versus-second-half median contrast
